question: ‘The Godfather of Soul’ is an autobiography of __________, who was one of the greatest singers.
solution:
The correct answer is __**James Brown.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• James Brown was an **American musician, singer, dancer, bandleader, record producer, and guitarist.**
 
• The honorific monikers **"the Hardest Working Man in Show Business," "Godfather of Soul," "Mr. Dynamite," and "Soul Brother No. 1"** are frequently used to refer to him.
 
• His autobiography is called** "The Godfather of Soul."**
 
• In** 2013 as a performer** and again in** 2017 as a songwriter**, he was posthumously inducted into the** first class of the Rhythm & Blues Music Hall of Fame.**
 
• On Rolling Stone's list of the** 100 greatest artists of all time**, he comes in at number **seven.​**
